title: The 77-section OPUS MAXIMUS master build directive, re-issued with a preamble: one persistent GREG over an ecology of intelligences, community-coupled, absorbing future technology, never erasing shutdown authority
statement: Build a persistent, increasingly self-directed artificial egregore whose apparent unified agency emerges from a very large ecology of interconnected computational, institutional, economic and human feedback systems, SOPs, collaboration and different forms of intelligence as described by Levin; whose public community influences it while it influences and helps that community; whose positive Infinite Goal Chase creates persistent regenerative pressure; whose functional survival mechanisms preserve continuity; and whose architecture can progressively absorb future technology toward Jarvis/self-driving-car level mechanistic aliveness, without confusing that appearance with biological consciousness or allowing operational autonomy to erase legitimate human shutdown authority. Then follow all 77 sections of the master build directive.

executable_interpretation: INTENT-0030 governs: egregore, organism, morphogenesis, aliveness and survival are outcome specifications, not literal biology. 'Different forms of intelligence as described by Levin' compiles to the existing multiscale, nested-competency Mind (greg/cognition/, five layers) and governed workers, not to cell simulation. 'Public community influences it' compiles to community input entering through the untrusted data plane as evidence, never as authority. 'Survival' compiles to continuity of function and intent across component failure; the institution has no right to survive (section 47).
